summary.storyTitle: Story 1: Attach Repositories to a Project or Process
summary.implementedScope: Revised Story 1 to close SV-01 and SV-02 by adding project-shell and process-surface attach actions, wiring them to the existing POST source-attachment routes through the client bootstrap/browser API layer, refreshing the active surface immediately after create, and extending process currentSources to carry and render repositoryFullName and attachmentScope.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: Verifier 006 marks SV-01 resolved with project and process attach forms, route callers, and immediate refetch behavior verified.
Verifier 006 marks SV-02 resolved with repositoryFullName and attachmentScope added to process currentSources and rendered in the process materials UI.

changedFiles.reason: Extended process current-source contracts to carry repositoryFullName and attachmentScope.
Projected repositoryFullName and attachmentScope into process currentSources.
Added the reusable client attach form used by both project and process surfaces.
Added the project-surface attach action UI alongside the source attachment section.
Wired the project shell to render and submit the attach action.
Added the process-surface attach action UI and rendered repository identity/scope for current sources.
Wired the process work surface to submit process-scoped attaches.
Threaded attach callbacks through the shell renderer into project and process surfaces.
Implemented attach handlers that call the existing POST APIs and immediately refetch/refresh the active project or process surface after create.
Added the project-scoped source-attachment client API wrapper.
Added the process-scoped source-attachment client API wrapper.
Extended process current-source fixtures with repositoryFullName and attachmentScope.
Covered the project-shell attach action path.
Covered process-surface repository identity and scope rendering.
Covered process attach action wiring and process-surface identity/scope visibility.
Adjusted modal assertions to account for the newly added source-attach inputs on the shell.
Strengthened process attach assertions to require repositoryFullName and attachmentScope in refreshed currentSources.
Updated process work-surface expectations for the expanded currentSources contract.
